files.title: Subexponential arithmetic matrix growth and a source-preserving return to RH
files.source_derived_content: Actual quotient holomorphy, rather than an assumed uniform operator norm, is enough via the source-specific strip return. Heat and metric errors must have subexponential total cost.
files.use_in_this_extension: Keep as the matrix-route alternative; the new pickup reduction asks only subpower growth of the retained means in the arithmetic cutoff.
files.retained_limitations: No all-depth growth bound or conditioning improvement is supplied by the paper. Forty Schur margins and the 128-dimensional bound are paper-reported, not replayed here.

files.title: Four-phase controls and the retained center
files.source_derived_content: Four real controls recover the mixed quadratic; growing analytic controls require the complete Pick matrix, range condition, and same-heat Schur complement. Refined complete hats have a vanishing delta-squared error.
files.use_in_this_extension: Retain both reflection channels and price the inverse of heat compression. Use its sampled-residual derivative estimate only with a complete net.
files.retained_limitations: Whole fixed-reader circle lower bound is refuted by its moving negative direction; the prescribed native reader remains unresolved. Four isolated blocks or four fixed nodes do not certify the full source.

files.title: Sofic-boundary certificates for the Weil screw kernel, revised
files.source_derived_content: Exact transverse Hodge-Tao heat on a Gaussian-integrable growing class; signed heat reconstruction; fixed-coordinate norm-corona tests; both parity blocks; full heat-to-zero Schur residual.
files.use_in_this_extension: Main backbone: correct upper/lower reflected charts, frequency-mass adapter, priced restoration, and a scalar arithmetic comparison on a uniqueness set.
files.retained_limitations: No source-wide positivity or shrinking collar is established. The reported 7/8 theorem is an external hypothesis, not a newly accepted input here. Ordinary L2 contraction is not the growing-profile Gaussian theorem.

files.title: Score-calibrated geometry, ordered arithmetic determinants, and subexponential zeta-matrix growth
files.source_derived_content: Separate numerator/denominator multiplicities have degrees 2m+2; their difference detects poles while retaining common factors. Growing radius controls only a specified harmonic inversion stage.
files.use_in_this_extension: Use as a possible local pole-detection backend for the retained mean/quotient, not as a replacement for Tao evolution or an all-plane search theorem.
files.retained_limitations: Gaussian smoothing of absolute squares differs from holomorphic heat. Calibration, physical window, total mass, and coefficient reconstruction remain explicit; no such backend executed here.

files.title: Harmonic reflections and exact signed-source certificates
files.source_derived_content: Self-contained actual signed pickup and moments; zero-mode drift/kernel/resolvent accounting; bounded-mass models cannot match the global zeta resolvent; subexponential pickup energy suffices.
files.use_in_this_extension: Supplies the pickup source and mass guard. New finite covariance-to-Hodge lift has mass alpha+sum a lambda^2, and the new centered transform retains every source principal part in the means.
files.retained_limitations: Witness selection and label unitarity are not arithmetic source invariance. Necessary vanishing harmonic mass and diverging total resolvent mass are not themselves sufficient.

files.title: Gross-Zagier, retained zero modes, and the original Riemann source
files.source_derived_content: The native cusp embedding preserves full signed correlation and cancels actual harmonic mass; the free cusp Hodge resolvent has a threshold limit, not the zeta target. Nontrivial scattering poles retain zeta multiplicities.
files.use_in_this_extension: Use the exact cusp embedding as a geometric input, with its threshold obstruction retained. Frequency-weighted spectral mass must grow in a successful arithmetic resolvent family.
files.retained_limitations: No Heegner-height identity for the native source or global resonance bound is supplied. Scattering resonances are not ordinary self-adjoint eigenvalues.

files.title: Global Emphasis Across Arithmetic and Phase Recursions
files.source_derived_content: Typed source, pairing, frame, and reconstruction maps; ordered errors receive their actual downstream amplification. Symmetry labels and geometric analogies need source adapters.

files.retained_limitations: BSD, quintic, theta, and moduli mechanisms remain distinct unless arithmetic comparison maps are proved. No unrelated BSD conclusion is imported into this zeta calculation.

files.title: Transported A2 weights and certified tensor return for arithmetic Hankel sections
files.source_derived_content: Transport metrics exactly; internal tensor metrics telescope; all binary carries, especially the terminal carry, are retained. Relative Hankel subexponential growth suffices for the matrix target.
files.use_in_this_extension: Optional coefficient backend with paid boundary scalars and full reconstruction error; not needed for the unconditional centered-transform calculation.
files.retained_limitations: The six-core 64-dimensional certificate is conditional on inherited coefficient intervals and is not replayed from PDFs. Low rank or small bond dimension does not prove all-depth norm growth.

files.title: Oscillator scans, logarithmic bases, and exact source preservation
files.source_derived_content: Exact two-phase inverse, complete five-part stencil, moving-base and ordered scan costs; unitary transport leaves the true source residual unchanged.

files.retained_limitations: Vanishing geometric scan error and bounded hat reconstruction do not prove the native lower bound. The 2+cos counterexample prevents treating positive Hodge models as the desired source.

files.title: Sofic-boundary certificates for the Weil screw kernel, original
files.source_derived_content: Each fixed rational Gram corner embeds isometrically and order faithfully; cyclic covariance gives positive finite features; the source comparison and analytic uniqueness limit are separate obligations.
